lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior gill region towards the caudal peduncle, forming a semi-regular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows, with high-luminance blobs positioned at several intersection nodes along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity light on the upper surface to deep shadow on the lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse and irregular distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs is visible across the medial and posterior surface area of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of micro-scale high-luminance spots is clustered on the rostrum and anterior cranial region, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs posterior to the gills.
